T0678.title: Mempool
T0678.definition: A mempool is a blockchain node's collection of valid transactions that have been received but not yet included in a block.
T0678.description: After checking a transaction's basic format, signature, and fee conditions, a node places it in its local mempool and propagates it across the network. Block producers select and order transactions from this pool. Public mempools improve propagation and transparency but expose pending transaction contents and bids, enabling front-running, sandwich attacks, censorship, and transaction copying.
T0678.usageExample: An arbitrage bot monitors the Mempool for a large swap and places transactions before and after it to form a sandwich attack.
